host_baseline.basis: measured once with the pinned host and a role's structured-output tool (athena.toml [agents]); not measured per invocation

cost.basis: Claude Code total_cost_usd, at list price

policy_denials.detail:
cat > studies/firstmate-work-handling/intro.json <<'EOF'
{
  "what": [
    {"text": "Firstmate takes an item from a backlog and gives it to a worker agent, which does the work in its own isolated worktree, a separate working copy of the project.", "claims": ["c1", "c22"]},
    {"text": "An agent decides what to dispatch and how to recover a stuck worker, while scripts enforce the gates: what may be dispatched, when a report is accepted, and when a worktree may be returned.", "claims": ["c2", "c10", "c12", "c17", "c21"]},
    {"text": "A person called the captain approves each merge unless the yolo setting is on.", "claims": ["c11"]}
  ],
  "walkthrough": [
    {"text": "The item waits in the backlog as Queued. A spawn is accepted only for an unheld, unblocked item.", "claims": ["c2"]},
    {"text": "Spawning moves the item to In flight and creates an isolated worktree for the worker. If every place of a declared capacity is held, the spawn exits 75 and the item stays queued.", "claims": ["c1", "c3", "c22"]},
    {"text": "When the worker reports a PR or ready branch, the report is refused while the work exists only in the worker's disposable copy.", "claims": ["c10"]},
    {"text": "The task then waits for the merge authority, which is the captain unless yolo is on.", "claims": ["c11"]},
    {"text": "Teardown returns the worktree only if it is clean and the committed work has landed, and it removes the task record and closes the backlog item as one step.", "claims": ["c12", "c13"]},
    {"text": "If the backlog close fails, the pending-close record is kept and the next session start retries it.", "claims": ["c14", "c15"]}
  ],
  "glossary": [
    {"term": "state", "about": "page", "definition": "A stage a piece of work can be in. The states are listed first, under States of a piece of work."},
    {"term": "transition", "about": "page", "definition": "A move from one state to another, shown as a card with its trigger and guard."},
    {"term": "trigger", "about": "page", "definition": "What starts a transition, and whether the agent or code decides that it has happened."},
    {"term": "guard", "about": "page", "definition": "The condition that must hold for a transition to go ahead, and whether the agent or code checks it."},
    {"term": "counter", "about": "page", "definition": "A number that some transitions change and others read, listed under Counters."},
    {"term": "claim", "about": "page", "definition": "One sentence about firstmate, with its sources. Each claim has an id such as c1; the bracketed ids on this page link to the claims listed at the end."},
    {"term": "pin", "about": "page", "definition": "The single firstmate commit the study read, shown at the top and in the footer. Nothing here describes any other version."},
    {"term": "mark", "about": "page", "definition": "The label on a claim that says how the study came to it, shown beside the claim at the end."},
    {"term": "backlog item", "definition": "A unit of work in a home's backlog, which is Queued, In flight or closed. Dispatch refuses an item the home does not have.", "claims": ["c1", "c2"]},
    {"term": "agent", "definition": "The part of firstmate that judges what to do, such as which harness to use or whether to recover a worker. Scripts check the shape of its choices.", "claims": ["c17", "c21"]},
    {"term": "worker", "definition": "An agent that carries out one task in its own worktree.", "claims": ["c3", "c18", "c22"]},
    {"term": "worktree", "definition": "A separate working copy of the project, isolated from the primary checkout, in which a worker does its task.", "claims": ["c22"]},
    {"term": "harness", "definition": "The kind of agent chosen for a dispatch. The agent picks it; scripts validate it.", "claims": ["c21"]},
    {"term": "spawn", "definition": "The script that dispatches a task: it moves the item to In flight and refuses when it cannot.", "claims": ["c1", "c3"]},
    {"term": "capacity", "definition": "An optional limit on the places a project has for workers. When all places are held, a spawn is deferred.", "claims": ["c3"]},
    {"term": "ship", "definition": "A kind of task, named next to scouts, whose finished work must be landed before its worktree is returned.", "claims": ["c10", "c12", "c18"]},
    {"term": "captain", "definition": "The person who approves merges and local-only landings when yolo is off.", "claims": ["c11"]},
    {"term": "yolo", "definition": "A setting that, when off, makes the captain approve every merge.", "claims": ["c11"]},
    {"term": "teardown", "definition": "The script that ends a task: it refuses a dirty worktree and removes the task record together with the backlog close.", "claims": ["c12", "c13"]},
    {"term": "pending-close record", "definition": "A record kept when a backlog close fails, so a later session start can replay the close.", "claims": ["c14", "c15"]},
    {"term": "stale wake", "definition": "A wake after which the agent inspects a worker that may have stopped, looped or gone quiet.", "claims": ["c17"]},
    {"term": "relaunch", "definition": "Replacing a running agent with a new one in the same worktree.", "claims": ["c18"]}
  ]
}
EOF
